newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber softens in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber softens in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grader SIR20 rubber prices softened in late trading amid bearish market sentiment, traders said.
They said deals were done at 45.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Surabaya and Palembang for August shipment. Offer prices in other centres were generally softer following the deals.
"In general, many traders believe Indonesian prices cannot compete with offer prices in Thailand or Malaysia because we are still engaged in long-term contracts," said one trader.

"It means of traders in those countries are offering rubber at much cheaper prices, we just can't follow suit. We also expect offer prices will fall again tomorrow because of slow demand and bearish market sentiment," he added.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 45.125 cents/lb fob Medan, 44.875 fob Padang, 45.00 fob Surabaya and Palembang and 44.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Traders earlier expected offer prices to fall to as low as 44.00 as the market continued to experience a lack of fresh leads.
